text:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up: AWS + Azure marketplace listings need to be published next Thursday 10:00 UTC. We still have open items: SKU/metering, pricing tier copy, SI integration docs, and HexaCompute co-announcement timing. Who can do final checks?

Liam O'Connor: I can own the AWS listing verification. Need the final SKU, AMI name, and the price-per-hour numbers. Also confirm if we list hourly + reserved pricing or just subscription.

Nora Feldman: Marketing asks we do subscription + usage-based meter for embeddings. That requires a clear meter name and unit. I'll compile the pricing language but need confirmation from product on rate limits.

Jacob Park: SI docs: integration walkthrough is near-ready. Missing the ARM template for Azure marketplace and a quickstart for private deploy. I'll paste the ARM snippet for the landing "Deploy" tab: 
```
{
  "$schema": "https://schema.management.azure.com/schemas/2019-04-01/deploymentTemplate.json#",
  "contentVersion": "1.0.0.0",
  "resources": []
}
```

Aisha Khan: Perfect. HexaCompute (HW partner) also requested a logo lock and co-announcement CTA. Their PR lead is asking for embargo copy 48h before. Can we do that?

press-bot: Reminder: embargo windows should be set to PDT for US outlets. Recommended send time: 48 hours prior to go-live. Use embargo template v3 in docs/press/templates.

Liam O'Connor: Quick legal flag: HexaCompute's brand team requires a logo checklist and the phrase "optimized for HexaCompute" needs approval. Partner legal wants that to read "validated on HexaCompute hardware" until certification is completed.

Nora Feldman: Noted — will change marketing copy to "validated on HexaCompute hardware". Also need high-res logo in SVG + a mono variant. @design-bot can you confirm sizes? :art: 

design-bot: Asset checklist: triangle hero SVG 1200x400, partner badge 300x80 (svg/png), favicon 32x32. Please upload to /assets/partners/hexa/ by EOD Tuesday.

Jacob Park: Ops/infra note: staging->prod migration window is Wed 22:00 UTC. We need to run the marketplace smoke test suite and the SI deploy test. I'll add the smoke test run to Jenkins pipeline.

Aisha Khan: Also confirm telemetry: product wants event names for marketplace purchase, subscription_change, and deploy_start. Send mapping to analytics by Tue noon.

Nora Feldman: I'll add the mapping to the public repo and tag analytics. Also adding a one-line snippet for the landing: "Get started in <5 minutes with our marketplace listing."

Liam O'Connor: One more: AWS marketplace requires a short security statement and a support contact. Do we want support@redwood.com or a partner-specific address?

Aisha Khan: Use support@redwood.com for now, partners can route to their channel in the partner spotlight module.

press-bot: Suggested embargo recipients: cloud-technical, infra reporters, partner PR contacts. Use single consolidated embargo email and CC partner PR.

Jacob Park: Action items I'm taking: add ARM snippet to docs, add smoke tests to pipeline, verify feature flag release gating.

Nora Feldman: Action items: update marketing copy with "validated on HexaCompute hardware", upload partner assets when provided, finalize pricing language.

Liam O'Connor: Action items: confirm AWS SKU/meter details and legal-approved partner phrasing.

Aisha Khan: I'll coordinate partner PR send, confirm staging window with ops, and run go/no-go checklist Tue 18:00 UTC. If HexaCompute logo approval doesn't come in by EOD Tue we ship with partner spotlight placeholder and update later.

Nora Feldman: Quick Q 1: do we want a small "co-announcement" banner in the blog or just a partner spotlight block? Co-auth blog will add 2 weeks to timeline.

Aisha Khan: Partner spotlight for the launch, co-auth blog as a follow-up.

Jacob Park: Pasting link to runbook: https://redwood.runbooks.io/marketplace-publish (internal).

Aisha Khan: Thanks all. Please update your assigned items here. Follow-up sync Tue 18:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
